title: feat(cli)!: the v18 upgrade carries stored comment reactions into sys_comment_reaction records, and the column drop waits for it
body:
Fixes #23281
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` now refuses the `sys_comment.reactions` drop until a verified conversion is recorded, and its two `--json` account-issuer refusals now exit 1, as their human face already did. Converting stored rows into an existing object widens no accept set (the gated-subcommand precedent is #21120). The semantic entry changes in prose only.

Dispatched by the `domain:services` seat 2 PM (claim comment 6150488591 on #23281), session `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE`, branch `claude/issue-23281-comment-reactions-upgrade-conversion`.

## What this does

The v18 retirement of `sys_comment.reactions` (`9963322fe8`) left every reaction a 17.x deployment stored in that column unread, and the drift remedy deleted them. Under the maintainer's rule that an upgrade keeps existing data (objectstack-ai/cloud#2843 `6145481762`), the upgrade now carries them:

- **`os migrate comment-reactions`** (new, `packages/cli`). Each (comment, emoji, user) in a stored map becomes one `sys_comment_reaction` row with the same comment, emoji and user, in the comment's `organization_id`, with `created_by` = the reactor (the key of the own-record delete floor, so the member can un-react it). A value that does not read is listed in the report with its comment id and converted into nothing: `not_json`, `not_a_map`, `not_a_user_list`, `not_a_user_id`, `emoji_not_storable` (bound read from the registered `sys_comment_reaction.emoji`), `unknown_user` (an id with no `sys_user` row). Readable entries of the same comment still convert. Dry run by default; `--apply` writes, re-reads the column, and records the run in `sys_migration` under `sys-comment-reactions-to-records`, verified only when everything readable is converted and nothing is unreadable. Idempotent on the natural key, so a re-run inserts nothing and finishes an interrupted run.
- **`os migrate apply --allow-destructive` holds the drop.** A column-specific refusal beside the existing `sys_account.issuer` retirement pre-flight, placed by the same rule (below the report, above the prompt, above both writes): the drop of `sys_comment.reactions` is refused (exit 1, `--json` `message: "refused_comment_reactions_unconverted"`) until the verified run is recorded. Every other drift entry and flag is unchanged. The boot drift line names that command as the remedy, so following it before converting is now safe.
- **The semantic entry** `18.sys-comment-reactions-column-retired.ts`: `replacement`, `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` prose name the conversion and order it before the drop. `id` and `surface` unchanged; no schema, `*.zod.ts`, contract or register change. The upgrade guide was regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:upgrade-guide` (it writes the gitignored `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/`, so nothing is committed; `18.md` carries the new prose) and `check:upgrade-guide` is green.
- `plugin-audit`'s `sys-comment.object.ts` docblock, `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (table row and a subsection), the two family tables that enumerate every `bootSchemaStack` caller, and one changeset (`@objectstack/cli` minor, `@objectstack/spec` patch) saying what the upgrade now carries.

## The PM's hypotheses, measured

- **H1 — holds.** On a booted database the column stays with its values; `os migrate plan` lists `sys_comment.reactions [drop_column]` as destructive. The raw read reuses `os migrate account-issuer`'s: `engine.getDriverForObject(name).find(...)` below the data door (the engine's `find` projects declared fields only). `sys_user` is read the same way (the data-migration boot composes no auth plugin).
- **H2 — holds.** The stored shape is objectui's `JSON.stringify({ [emoji]: userIds[] })` (`RecordDetailView.tsx` `storedReactions`). The six unreadable reasons above are reported, never guessed.
- **H3 — holds.** Natural key `(comment_id, emoji, user_id)`; the declared `unique: 'organization'` index refuses a duplicate (`DUPLICATE_RECORD`, seen in ablation 1 below). Each row carries its comment's organization.
- **H4 — measured.** No code in this repo fires a notification or automation on a reaction insert; the data-migration boot composes no automation runtime. plugin-audit's reaction create gate returns early for a system write, so `user_id` keeps the stored reactor (an unexempted gate would have replaced or refused it). The writes use the bookkeeping context the organization seed claim uses, `{ isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true }`; audit stamps and code hooks still run. Found on the way: `created_by` must be the reactor or the member cannot un-react a converted reaction; it is carried in the row (the stamp hook assigns nothing without a session user).
- **H5 — partly falsified.** `audit-metadata-bodies` records no `sys_migration` row and is not journal-backed; `value-shapes` records the row; only `recorded-by` / `meta` use the ADR-0119 journal. The shape taken: `audit-metadata-bodies`'s boot, dry run and idempotent rewrite, plus `value-shapes`'s ledger row. No journal: every reaction is one atomic insert and the natural-key guard makes each re-run the resume.
- **H6 — falsified as stated, landed through the existing mechanism that does it.** `files-to-references`' column-step refusal gates that command's own column move on its own gate; it cannot hold back `os migrate apply`. The mechanism that holds back one destructive drop inside `os migrate apply` is the `sys_account.issuer` retirement pre-flight; this adds its sibling for one column. It reads a ledger row rather than re-measuring live, deliberately: after conversion a member may un-react, and a live probe would read that deleted row as unconverted and either refuse the drop forever or, worse, re-create the reaction if the operator re-ran the conversion to satisfy it. No path can write the column after v18 (the data door refuses it), so a verified run stays true until the column is gone.

## Measured on a booted composition (before the pins)

`pnpm dev:todo -- -p PORT --database file:SCRATCH/react.db` (`SqlDriver(better-sqlite3)`, Audit plugin composed, branch at `f5db79977e`), signed in as the seeded admin; a second user made with the admin create-user door; four comments posted through `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment`. The server was stopped and the 17.x leftover planted by hand: `ALTER TABLE sys_comment ADD COLUMN reactions TEXT` (v17 declared it a textarea) and four v17-shaped values: `{👍:[admin,m2],🎉:[m2]}`, `{❤️:[admin],👀:[]}`, `"not json at all"`, `{👍:[m2,"usr_deleted_since"],🚀:3}`.

| step | exit | `sys_comment_reaction` rows | `sys_migration` row | column |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| before | | 0 | none | present |
| `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes --json` | 1 `refused_comment_reactions_unconverted` | 0 | none | present |
| `os migrate comment-reactions --json` (dry run): 4 scanned, 5 readable, 5 to convert, 3 unreadable (`not_json`, `not_a_user_list`, `unknown_user`) | 1 | 0 | none | present |
| `… --apply --yes --json`: 5 converted, `created_by` and `organization_id` as the reactor and the comment's org | 1 | 5 | `verified_at null`, `blocking 3` | present |
| `… --apply` again: 0 converted, 5 already, `failures []` | 1 | 5 | `blocking 3` | present |
| `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` | 1 refused (`blocking 3`) | 5 | | present |
| operator clears one value, keeps the readable part of the other; `… --apply` | 0, verified | 5 | `verified_at` set, `blocking 0` | present |
| `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes --json` | 0, `applied: sys_comment drop_column reactions` | 5 | | gone |
| `pnpm dev:todo` on the same file | no `[schema-drift]` line; `GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction` as admin answers the 5 rows; admin `DELETE`s its own converted reaction: `200` | 4 | | gone |

## Pins (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/comment-reactions.integration.test.ts`)

One real SQLite file under the SQL driver the commands boot, schema made by `os migrate apply --yes` (the served composition with an auth secret), then the 17.x column and values planted by hand. Seven ordered cases through the commands' own `run()`: (1) drop refused before any conversion, `{ message: 'refused_comment_reactions_unconverted', detail, conversion: null, applied: [] }`, exit 1, column present; (2) dry run: exact counts, the four unreadable entries with their comment ids, nothing written; (3) `--apply`: rows equal the expected set (same comment, emoji, user; comment's organization; `created_by` = reactor), unreadable listed, nothing for the unreadable comment, ledger `{ verified_at: null, blocking: 4 }`; (4) a re-run inserts nothing, `{ alreadyConverted: 5, converted: 0, failures: [] }`; (5) drop still refused with the recorded run under `conversion`; (6) after the operator resolves the values, verified, exit 0; (7) the drop proceeds and every row survives.

### Negative-pin ablations (fix committed first; each run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock, with a `trap` restore; both restored to the HEAD blob `1c075685b2e1`, `git diff HEAD` empty)

1. **Idempotency guard removed** (`if (held.has(reactionKey(…)))` → `if (false && held.has(…))`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `1c075685b2e1` → `dd02d298f4c0`): red, 5 failed / 2 passed. Case 4: `- "alreadyConverted": 5 / + "alreadyConverted": 0`, `- "failures": [] / + "failures": [ { "code": "DUPLICATE_RECORD", "commentId": "rx_c1", "emoji": "👍", … } × 5 ]` — the declared unique index refused every duplicate; the report is what the pin reads.
2. **Unreadable report entry removed** (the parse-level `report.unreadable.push(…)` deleted, anchor 1 → 0, blob → `75af39952334`): red, 3 failed / 4 passed. Cases 2 and 3: the expected `not_json` / `not_a_user_id` / `not_a_user_list` entries missing, only `unknown_user` received.

## Local verification (at HEAD `bf15e3062a`, after merging `origin/main` at `5c9bfb0d3f`)

- Build: `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=2` green (74 tasks) after the merge.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` clean; `check:test-typecheck: OK` (3 files / 28 errors / 6 pinned signatures held in the existing ledger; the new test adds none).
- `@objectstack/cli` integration, the three files this diff touches or depends on (`comment-reactions.integration.test.ts`, `apply.account-issuer-retirement.integration.test.ts`, `schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts`): 3 files, 99 tests passed. The seven new cases take 0.1 to 0.65 s each.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit tier (`vitest run --project unit`): 286 files, 4288 tests passed.
- `@objectstack/spec` `pnpm test`: 669 files, 20276 passed, 1 todo. `@objectstack/plugin-audit` (`sys-comment-retired-fields.test.ts`, `objects.test.ts`, `sys-comment-reactions-door.integration.test.ts`): 3 files, 22 passed.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 118 families from 10 changed paths; all 118 ran, each exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 118 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 118 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 118 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).` Among them `check:upgrade-guide` (`✓ protocol-upgrade-guide.md generates from the ADR-0087 registries`), `check:spec-changes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:tenant-audit-census` (`OK -- 225 write call sites certified`), `check:nul-bytes` (`OK … no raw ASCII control bytes`), `check:adr-0087-registration` (`this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset`).
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 8 changed `.ts` files: 8 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population is the config's own: every changed file matches `**/*.{ts,…}` and none sits in `NEVER_LINTED`; `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Patch round 1 (at `42b3638b94`; the seat's amendment `6152677078`, the dev's report `6153407686`)

- **Grading:** the card is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: the destructive apply refuses a drop it accepted before. The changeset now carries a bang summary, a **BREAKING** (accept-set narrowing) banner and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (already-registered sys-comment-reactions-column-retired)`. `check:adr-0087-registration` passes: `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (already-registered)`.
- **The `--json` account-issuer refusals now exit 1.** This was measured first at the real command (`os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes` on legacy-shaped SQLite databases). Under `--json`, `refused_account_issuer_collisions` and `refused_account_issuer_preflight_unreadable` exited `0`, while the human face exited `1`. Both now exit `1`. The pins are in `apply.account-issuer-json-refusal.test.ts`: exit 1, the `message`, and nothing written, with a human-face control and a clean-pre-flight control.
- **Ablation:** with both sites put back to `0`, the two new pins go red (`AssertionError: expected +0 to be 1`) and both controls stay green. Restored: blob == HEAD (`4fe54313fc9f`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **QA checklist:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`, item `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json`, now lists the 16 subcommands `os migrate --help` registers. Added: `organization-ownership`, `security-catalog-overlays` and `comment-reactions`.
- **Gates at `42b3638b94`:** 119 derived, 119 run. 118 exit 0. `check:platform-checklist` exits 1 on 8 symbol anchors outside this diff (`access-security.json`, `search.json`, `attachments-storage.json`). The same 8 lines appear without this PR's edit, and on `origin/main` `404fc477e5`. Per `lint.yml`, that gate runs as a daily watchdog on `main`, not per PR.
- **Tests:** cli typecheck clean; cli integration 3 files, 99 passed; cli unit tier 287 files, 4292 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- `os migrate apply --json`'s two `sys_account.issuer` pre-flight refusals (`refused_account_issuer_collisions`, `refused_account_issuer_preflight_unreadable`) emit with exit code 0 (`emitJson(…, 0, …)` then `return`), while this PR's sibling refusal exits 1. Read from the code, not measured at the door; noted, not filed.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` (the migrate item) enumerates 13 `os migrate` subcommands as variants; the tree now registers more (`organization-ownership`, `security-catalog-overlays`, and this `comment-reactions` among them). A checklist sweep owns it; noted, not filed.
- The CLI e2e `test/json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` (nightly tier) gains the new command in its derived family; it was not run locally.
